sanjay (Pioneer): Hey team — onboarding hit a wall. Our web app fires ~60 parallel embed SDK inits on first page load and after today's deploy we're seeing a bunch of 429s from the Redwood edge. Error body says rate limit + retry_after. Any quick mitigation while we investigate?

maria (CS): Sorry about the friction — can you paste the exact error body and any request headers you see? Are you using ephemeral tokens in-browser or a server-side API key?

sanjay (Pioneer): error snippet:
```
429 {\"message\":\"rate limit\", \"retry_after\": 12}
Request-ID: ax-789
Authorization: Bearer ephemeral_tok_abc...\n```
We're using ephemeral tokens minted from our backend (30s TTL) and the client refresh code fetches new token on every init.

maria (CS): ok that TTL is pretty short for heavy fanout. Immediate mitigations you can try client-side: gate/consolidate init calls, add jitter/backoff, or switch to a server-signed session token for the initial page load. I can also temporarily bump your account cap while you patch.

alex (Eng): Likely a preflight/token-stampede. When many clients request the ephemeral token simultaneously and each triggers an edge-level preflight, buckets spike. Two short-term paths: 1) increase ephemeral token validity to ~60–120s so clients reuse the same token during the first-page traffic window; 2) implement single-signer pattern (server mints one token and shares it to page).
Also run this to look at our preflight logs: `rz logs --filter preflight-init --since 1h | jq -r '. | "\(.timestamp) \(.request_id) \(.status)"' | head -n 50`

tom (SE): On the SDK side we pushed a quick client patch that: 1) limits concurrent init to 6, 2) adds randomized jitter (rand between 200–600ms) before preflight, and 3) switches to exponential backoff with cap (base 200ms, factor 2, max 5 retries). Patch link: https://git.local/pioneer/sdk/merge/432 (internal).

maria (CS): I've opened a temporary account-level lift for Pioneer: +20rps for 48h while you roll the fix and roll back TTL change if needed. Enabled DEBUG preflight logs for your org; you'll see more detail in Console -> Observability -> Requests.

sanjay (Pioneer): thanks — re-tested after the SDK patch + minor TTL bump to 60s. 429s dropped dramatically (roughly -95%). Warm starts look fine. We'll keep monitoring for the next 24h.

alex (Eng): long-term we should add a recommended pattern in our onboarding guide: 1) avoid per-tab ephemeral tokens <30s for initial high-fanout pages, 2) prefer server-side signed session tokens for heavy initial loads, 3) always add client jitter + concurrency cap. I'll open an internal RFC for an SDK-first defense (singleflight preflight + local cache).

tom (SE): For customers who cannot change token TTL, we can add an SDK flag `single_preflight: true` so one tab does the expensive work and others reuse the result. Quick PR ready if you want it toggled for Pioneer.

maria (CS): I'll create a KB entry for this pattern (ephemeral token preflight stampede) and attach the reproduction steps + mitigations. Will paste link here when available. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment succeeded pioneer/sdks/edge-jitter-fix @ 1749994000

sanjay (Pioneer): Confirmed — after deploy + SDK patch, all good. Appreciate the quick help. Can you add the KB so our infra folks have a reference?

maria (CS): Absolutely — created placeholder: https://redwood.ai/kb/ephemeral-preflight-stampede (will fill with logs & code samples). I'll follow up in 24h with metrics and close the loop.
